findings.issue: Suspended manual backup admits an invalid job which rolls back claim and blocks dispatch
findings.fix: Reject suspended/WAL-disabled requests before enqueue. Validate provisional claims before persisting leases. Retire deterministically invalid, provably unissued backup control requests in a committed transaction; quarantine previously issued/uncertain work. Keep backend capacity held; deliver the valid job behind it. Transient persistence/key failures are not classified as safely unissued external success.

findings.issue: Registry archival leaves autonomous CNPG recurrence installed
findings.fix: 0051 guards actual project and customer status transitions, including Default-project cascades. Require fresh, matching observed suspension, WAL disabled and retention deletion disabled, or an exact previously completed physical purge proof. Scope row locks serialize archival against new grants. Guards never fabricate sessions/controller principals or silently change WAL/retention rights. Registry only adds the narrow SQLSTATE-to-conflict mapping.

findings.issue: Resize drifts policy resource revision and removes Barman/replay headroom
findings.fix: Scoped 0051 ordering-worker function advances only the exact admitted policy/resource revision; no general policy UPDATE grant. Supersede only unissued queued backup work, retain rights/credentials/archive UID, reject issued conflicting work, and automatically reconfigure/reobserve after actual resize. Preserve native quota headroom using main-allocation markers so retry after quota commit cannot add delta twice.

findings.issue: Inventory fails after 100 objects and stale successful observation remains configured
findings.fix: Scan 100-object provider pages at a consistent resource version, retaining only the latest completed scheduled candidate. Failed/manual entries cannot win; provider history is not deleted. Native scan is lease-guarded; callbacks remain one bounded proof. A known failure immediately invalidates the current observed timestamp; public configured/suspended state also requires a fresh observation. Obsolete callbacks cannot clear a newer policy revision.
